title: Tuxedo Brass Band roster when Happy joined
summary: Happy lists members of the Tuxedo band, including Shots, the Pajot, Russo, Sonny and old man Tats; he played snare, then moved to bass drum.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in the tuxedo brass band then?

The tuxedo man was, the way I was in it, was Southern Stan, Shots, and the Pajot, and the trumpets. And the little Aranza, the teal, and the. And August Russo, on Tramon, Sonny, on Tramon, and old man Taton. Old man Taton. I ain't talking about the E-says, or the saxophone tat. It's Paul.
Yeah. He used to go to writing for the bass. And that old man would write too, buddy. He could put some stuff on paper. And, and old man, Bob was on the alto.
Taton played baritone? Yeah, it was baritone, but I had to. Because that's, that's God, man. And Trapania on bass drumming you on.
Yeah, Trapania on bass drumming you on.
And I was on snare. Well, after Trapania got out, who, who, who played snare then? You switched to bass?
I switched to bass. What was the way you see? Different ones. Different ones, I see. Yeah. Until I quit. I quit. Mm-hmm. Quit the record. I quit the band. Mm-hmm.
